note: Generation-fenced footer inventory; source bodies were not downloaded.

fix.shape: Decode column vectors without per-column physical row-reference arrays; aligned cursors generate references once per output batch.

budget.note: Reservations are conservative allowances, not measured cloud billing.

next_blocker.shape: TLS flush truncation fixed; complete public search and full-archive qualification.
next_blocker.diagnosis: A focused production builder reproduced Timeout during segment_statistics GCS PUT. TLS flush discarded a plaintext tail when ciphertext framing filled its output buffer; preserving and draining that tail fixes the exact-buffer loopback regression.
next_blocker.required_work: Complete serving-path cold/warm/filter/concurrent/deep-cursor/restart samples and full-archive qualification after actual-charge reconciliation permits another bounded cloud attempt.

bounded_construction.shape: Per-file replay, metadata sorts, text DF reduction and durable non-serving checkpoints; renewed full-definition CAS and vacuum protection.

predicate_capacity_fix.shape: Limit predicate sort runs to four within the fused ordered builders shared 64-file manager; record synchronized spill file/byte admission diagnostics.
predicate_capacity_fix.regression: 55 sibling files plus 5000 distinct predicate blocks, with repeated merges, sorted values and zero retained spill bytes.
predicate_capacity_fix.cloud_failure_attribution: The constrained-capacity regression demonstrates a remaining risk; the previous cloud error does not identify its exact limit site.

search_diagnostic.scope: One unchanged raw BigQuery Parquet file, separately generation-fenced and copied server-side; does not qualify full-archive latency.
search_diagnostic.source_copy_note: Retained for attempt six, then deleted with its recorded generation after both pods stopped.

construction_recovery_harness.shape: Record Timeout/DeadlineExceeded observations and allow the engine queued checkpoint recovery within the original absolute build deadline; permanent admission errors fail immediately.
construction_recovery_harness.note: The first diagnostic aborted at its first timeout; it did not wait for the already queued engine retry.

predicate_capacity_rerun.credential_diagnosis: Consistent with cached bearer expiration; original token expiry was not recorded, so attribution is unconfirmed.

credential_lifetime_admission.shape: Force refresh once per pod, require expiry beyond its remaining hard deadline, reuse the admitted token across cycles, persist only nonsecret expiry evidence.

search_diagnostic_retry.scope: One unchanged 142,577-row raw BigQuery Parquet file; does not qualify full-archive latency.
search_diagnostic_retry.error: Index not queryable within 2700-second build deadline
search_diagnostic_retry.concurrent_maintenance_note: Artifact collection remained in its mark phase with no eligible deletions; its trace is retained without attributing the construction failure to maintenance.
search_diagnostic_retry.checkpoint_reuse_evidence: Retry generations share the five completed ordered child-tree reference sets; full-text file contribution remains incomplete.
search_diagnostic_retry.note: Native transfer probes ran during construction; pod-wide build network counters include their traffic. No search measurements were taken.

native_gcs_transfer_probes.scope: Native Linux fast HTTP client in the existing diagnostic pod; authenticated GCS media operations on only the owned run prefix, separate from search workloads.
native_gcs_transfer_probes.conclusion: Basic large-body GCS transfers work; the exact higher-level Timeout stage remains unconfirmed.

text_build_diagnostics.shape: Log publication/checkpoint phase and text source-row, ordinal-page, encoding/pack and statistics stages; include only generation/file ordinal, completed segment count and error. Preserve the original error and suppress cancellation warnings.
text_build_diagnostics.keep_alive_tls_upload_regression: 24 KiB, 1 MiB and 8 MiB request bodies verified on one reused localhost TLS connection.

tls_flush_fix.shape: Consume only encrypted plaintext and repeat flush until the buffer is empty; engine HTTP timeouts unchanged.
tls_flush_fix.regression_after: Passed with TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3, including exact plaintext-buffer capacity and reused connections.
tls_flush_fix.scope: Focused native aarch64-macos fast production publication builder, testing allocator, body-only schema and local unchanged raw Parquet source with real GCS artifacts. Excludes coordinator, serving API and public search measurements.

filesystem_publication.note: Testing allocator; correctness diagnostic, not performance qualification.

tls_flush_fix.billing_reconciliation: Export usage predates the final diagnostic jobs; reservations cannot yet be released.

fixed_completion_gcs.remaining_work_sample: Document-frequency statistics Builder.add -> PageStore.get -> GCS getObject -> HTTP socket receive; one-second sample, not a performance attribution.
